findings.title: Timing attack in login
findings.description: Login checks User::where('username')->first() before Hash::check, leaking username existence through response timing. Refactor to always perform Hash::check even when user is not found, using a dummy hash.

findings.title: Missing rate limiting
findings.description: Login endpoint has no throttle, allowing unlimited brute-force attempts. Apply throttle:api middleware or a custom login throttle.

findings.title: No token expiration
findings.description: Sanctum tokens never expire. Compromised tokens remain valid until explicitly revoked. Publish and configure config/sanctum.php with expiration value or implement manual expiration logic.

findings.title: Double hashing in seeder
findings.description: SuperAdminSeeder calls Hash::make('admin123') but the User model already has password: 'hashed' cast, hashing the password twice. Remove Hash::make from the seeder and pass plain text. Same issue exists in tests.
